criterion_text: Managed creation pins resolved source+image digests, prepares local cached EROFS, launches an authorized Sandbox initial Pane on a capable Linux Agent, and never silently falls back to Native if preparation/isolation fails.

verifiers.summary: Managed creation pins and authorizes every artifact, prepares the Agent cache and composition, and refuses missing or unverifiable artifacts instead of falling back to Native

evidence.value: exact SHA 4745ddbfa9426b1470967bb988242b496a6ae02e: the managed create protocol carries the Base Runtime and Project Source digests plus one scoped grant per artifact; unknown fields are refused

exact SHA 4745ddbfa9426b1470967bb988242b496a6ae02e: the Server resolved ready artifacts, minted per-artifact grants, sent a managed create with no host working directory and recorded a ready managed context with the resolved source commit; missing or non-ready artifacts were refused

exact SHA 4745ddbfa9426b1470967bb988242b496a6ae02e: the Agent downloaded and verified every image into its identity cache, built and compiled the `/` + `/workspace` + `/opt/rust` composition with an Agent-owned writable workspace; a missing image or digest mismatch failed closed with no workspace and no Native fallback
